Capcom Fight 2003.name: Soul Falchion
Capcom Fight 2003.summary:
Soul Falchion is a weapon-based fighting game using Takara's engine.

It has 20 characters, most (if not all) of which are based on characters from SNK's Last Blade and Samurai Shodown series, renamed (some with names taken from Mortal Kombat), slightly modified and recolored. The sprites are smaller versions of the sprites used in the Neo Geo Pocket Color games.

Dogz.name: Dogz
Dogz.summary: In December 1999, a Game Boy Color port of Dogz (also known as Dogz - Your Virtual Petz Pals) as well as a companion port of Catz was released.

Hunter x Hunter - Kindan no Hihou.name: Hunter X Hunter: Kindan no Hihou
Hunter x Hunter - Kindan no Hihou.summary: Hunter x Hunter: Kindan no Hihou is a Japanese adventure game for the Game Boy Color.

Kakurenbo Battle - Monster Tactics.name: Kakurenbo Battle: Monster Tactics
Kakurenbo Battle - Monster Tactics.summary: A top-down strategy game set in a dungeon. Your sight is limited; hide in the shadows and move around to reveal more of the dungeon and lead your team to victory.
